attempts.summary: Installed and configured dnsmasq on node1 to resolve inventory-api.internal to node2's IP (10.100.211.11), and configured node2's resolvconf to use node1 (10.100.211.10) as its primary DNS resolver. Verified resolution works both locally on node1 and from node2 via node1. Completed mandatory restart protocol: restarted node1 then node2 sequentially, confirmed changed boot IDs on both, and verified dnsmasq service and DNS resolution recovered correctly after each restart.
